DML.SELECT: SELECT user_id as "userId", system_permission_id as "systemPermissionId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.user_permissions WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.user_permissions (user_id, system_permission_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:userId, :systemPermissionId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.user_permissions WHERE user_id = :userId AND system_permission_id = :systemPermissionId
